title: EXAONE金融预测模型
summary: EXAONE Finance是面向金融时间序列预测的基础模型，采用无注意力架构，用因果一维卷积和分组池化MLP替代自注意力，实现线性时间计算。通过掩码上下文增强处理缺失数据，在涵盖多资产类别的FinVerse基准上取得最优性能。
summary_en: EXAONE Finance is a financial time-series foundation model with an attention-free architecture using causal 1D convolution and group-aware pooling MLP for linear-time computation. Masked context augmentation handles missing data. It achieves state-of-the-art on FinVerse benchmark across multiple asset classes.
